notes.title: Roguelite Deck-Builder 《Emblem of Valor》 Now Available for Steam by EA!
notes.content:
Produced by indie game developer “Far Star Studio”, published by indie game
publisher Game Bridge, Roguelite strategy card game “Emblem of Valor” undergone
series of polishing and changes with feedback from players and community, such as
reworking on UI and implementing new challenges, now release Early Access on Steam
allowing players to look into the differences from the demo version.

[h2]Around 400 unique cards for deck building[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223348/32a766b07c4776764c7d4e5859bc5fe81246d666.png[/img]
《Emblem of Valor》encourages players to adopt diverse strategies and unique combat
styles. Including common cards used in battles, cards from five different class as well as
dual-class cards, players can explore nearly 400 cards with varying effects and experience
different archetype combinations.

[h2]5 major maps[/h2]
Each map has its unique field effect, monster distribution, events and route.
[list]
[*]Forest:inhabited by a variety of ferocious beasts and monsters, has a dense
and twisted terrain that will impede players' movement and attacks, but it may
sometimes also provide cover for players.
 [*]Mountain:features harsh weather, including gales, rain, and even lightning
strikes. Players must be wary of ambushes from aerial monsters and elemental
disasters hidden among storms and rocks.
[*]Swamp:Being poisoned will slow you down, a small spark might lead to a
massive explosion. Here, insects and plant monsters gather. Even if the
individual entities are very weak, when they gather, they will become a
nightmare.
[*]Cave:Full of cave-dwelling creatures and monsters from underground. In the
confined environment, the number of plays and actions will be limited.
[*]Ruin:Occupied by undead, specters, and mysterious mechanical creations.
Ancient curses and unknown energies reside here, which may cause
unexpected mutations to the deck in hand.

[/list]

[h2]Replayability[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223348/ce8b146022046e49c29f9a2affebfec8d621e50b.png[/img]
Collect soul power to repair the Shattered Realm, unlock more levels and boss battles.
[list]
[*]Guardian Colossus:Powerful guardians in the depth of ruins, strong
resistance to both physical and magic damage.
[*]Bone Dragon:Death defying dragon lurks among the swamps, its flames and
claws comes with plaguing venom.
[/list]

[h2]Dive into the stories of each character[/h2]
We reworked the tutorial, now players can gradually learn more about
the backstories of the lone guardians and lost heroes in “Call of the Shattered
Realm” mode.

[h2]Raising the difficulties[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223348/0713b108507aedffe8f69fcf43349d465fb06eb8.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Advanced difficulties:Gradually unlock 10 levels of difficulties every time you
clear a stage, each time with new challenges.
[*]Darkmist effect:Navigate through different debuffs caused by different
effects of darkmist, testing players’ wisdom and survival skills.
[/list]

[h2]Creative workshop[/h2]
In the game, players can now access to built-in editor to edit the content of the game,
including cards, equipment, characters and monsters. Players who are interested in
MODs can also create MOD and upload to Steam’s workshop!
We are still hard on work on the function and UI of the editor, and we look forward
players feedback and comments. We welcome players from every corner of the world to
build and shape this game together!


We will continue to gather player feedback and adjust the game, add new
game modes and gameplay, we hope to bring a deck building game that fits players’
demand with the full version in the future!

notes.title: Indie Publisher Game Bridge will exhibit Emblem of Valor at Taipei Game Show!
notes.content:
Indie game publisher Game Bridge will exhibit three titles with very different styles at Taipei Game Show 2025!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223348/9ba54dccc27d79dab6e8c24a07585bb03fbb8c12.jpg[/img]

At Taipei Game Show, which will be held from January 23rd to January 26th this year, indie game publisher Game Bridge will exhibit three titles in different styles at booth A09 at "Indie House"! Players will not only be able to try out the game at the booth, but there will also be gifts for the players! Come and try out! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223348/eb6af4992afeabc595788c0100b8db61e8d3a4a5.png[/img]

Roguelike deck-building game " Emblem of Valor " 
" Emblem of Valor " is a roguelike deck-building game combined with RPG elements. Form your party, level up your characters, collect powerful cards and equipments to overcome all 
threats in the Shattered Realm and prove your valor! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223348/f16b5454435da28fc09656431c986fc49658ca88.png[/img]

With dynamic stage options, each run will be unique. Carefully choose your path in each stage selection - more dangerous stages may yield richer reward, however your deck will also be put up against greater challenges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223348/b0fbc618f183b89f16479313737d3a55cf1bf7ec.png[/img]

Aside from dynamic stages, monsters and events on the map are randomly generated in each playthrough. Special events also feature class-specific options, greatly increasing replayability!

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223348/deb9838dceb2c66cdbd2e8d31c0a8f5f8e1ddde0.png[/img]

This year at Taipei Game Show 2025, we have prepared a special demo version, aiming to let players try out the core gameplay and deck building in short spans of time.

notes.title: Recent development progress & Early access timlime changed
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We were delighted to participate in Steam's NextFest in February and receive so much valuable player feedback - thank you to everyone who supported us! However, we also realized that the current game experience is still incomplete for many players. Some gameplay elements are difficult to grasp, and there are issues with content variety and balance that need urgent improvement.

After team discussion, if we proceeded with our original Early Access launch in March, the gameplay experience may fail to meet player expectations. Although it's an early access and not the full release, we don't want players to feel the game is unfinished.

[u]For these reasons, we have decided to postpone the release until later this year in Q3 or Q4. We sincerely apologize for only announcing this delay now.[/u]

During this extension period, we will focus on improving the following aspects:

[h3]Description text and UI improvements[/h3]
Many players highlighted issues like cluttered icons or confusing effect descriptions in the current demo version. For those less familiar with this genre, even with the existing tutorials, getting into the gameplay can be difficult. The early levels also frontload too many complex effects.

To address this, we are working to improve effect readability and provide simpler explanations where possible. We will also streamline early game complexity and improve the tutorials.

[h3]Multi-Character Combat System[/h3]
The multi-class, multi-character combat is a core aspect of Emblem of Valor. However, we found many players struggling with the current multi-character combat mechanics when using parties. Some barely utilized character switching, while others felt it was too cumbersome with low payoff.

Going forward, we want to better define the role of character switching. We will reduce the need for frequent swapping while adding more unique abilities tied to each character beyond just their card pools.

[h3]Environment Effects [/h3]
Currently, map choices only differ in size and quest objectives. But there are no significant combat differences between maps, potentially making strategic selection feel lacking in depth for some.

Thus, we will add unique environment effects to different maps, as well as stronger synergies between certain monsters and maps, to make each map stand out more.

[h3]More Characters and Playstyles[/h3]
Our original Emblem of Valor design was based around five core classes (Fighter, Mage, Cleric, Ranger, Rogue). We really want to provide all five for players in the next major release.

However, balancing the unique strengths of each class while allowing diverse deckbuilding combinations is a major challenge for us. Our goal is for each class to offer a complete standalone playstyle, while also enabling new strategies when combined.

[h3]Others [/h3]
Beyond the above, we are also working on smoother multi-language support, additional VFX and visual feedback, improved narrative content, and roguelike staples like unlock systems.

This outlines our updated development roadmap. We again apologize for the delay and any inconvenience caused.

Thank you for your patience and support.

Sincerely,
Far Star Studio

notes.title: Demo Reopened and Beta Version Update
notes.content:
Greetings players! It's been a while.

Over the past few months since the demo was taken down, we have been hard at work fixing issues from the previous build and improving the core gameplay loop. Today, we're excited to announce the demo will be available again! The game has also now entered beta, with various systems being more complete. We welcome everyone to come try out the new gameplay modes and content!

Here's a quick overview of changes and new features in this build:

[h2]New Modes[/h2]
In addition to the original training mode, we've added an adventure mode with more randomness and core gameplay, as well as an endless mode for pushing your limits through unlimited challenges.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223348/9ed4b2b7a460185f408ddd7d22077ee9179db767.png[/img]
Although only some levels are available in the current demo, we'll continue updating it and work hard to deliver more content in the full release!

[h2]Randomized Maps[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223348/f67b25bbe56a62de7ff3abdc4a22c137af3ccb21.png[/img]
Unlike the fixed training maps previously, the new modes feature procedural generation for more diverse gameplay each run.

[h2]Quest System[/h2]
The new quest system provides objectives and rewards for each map. Players can pick missions and levels suiting their party's needs, adding more strategy to map selection.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223348/6f5f281900d15b29653e2725df2b218cfc30c8a9.png[/img]

[h2]Voidmist System[/h2]
The Voidmist system is another core feature. In this version, we've improved it to create an experience unlike other games.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223348/c7d3250f852d7c23f91a2c51a2c7dd41d59fd95d.png[/img]
In short, Voidmist gradually increases as players explore the map. With higher Voidmist levels, enemies have a chance to gain Voidmist enhancements, requiring more careful path selection strategies.

Voidmist effects also differ each run, incentivizing repeated play.

[h2]Card Upgrades[/h2]
Campfires now offer card upgrades with branching choices, in addition to healing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223348/793dab12dede714cbd053f013f8b96d406be680d.png[/img]

[h2]Multi-Character Combat[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223348/92e39a4d6a3ba37bb488eac0884df09395554eee.png[/img]
Based on feedback, we've streamlined the combat flow when using multiple characters, removing the need to activate each character every turn. But you can still adjust turn order mid-fight. This should reduce the operational burden while retaining strategic depth.

[h2]Other[/h2]
The above covers only some of the changes. Here are some other updates to discover in-game:

[list]
[*] UI improvements
[*] New music/sound effects
[*] More cards and enemies
[*] Ending screen
[/list]

We hope you'll enjoy all the new content! Please let us know your thoughts. Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Recent development progress
notes.content:
Greetings players!

It's been a while since we released the demo earlier this year. We've received invaluable feedback from many players and identified areas where the gameplay can be improved. During this time, besides fixing existing issues, we've also been hard at work developing and testing content not shown in the demo, including:

- Dynamic levels and random-generated events
- Different difficulties settings and associating monster behavior AI 
- Card unlocking system
- Quest and reward system
- Voidmist mechanics 
- Active character abilities
- More diverse cards/equipment/items/skill effects
- Numerous balance tweaks and UI adjustments

Since the new systems took up most of our small 2-person team's time, we haven't sent regular updates or patches for the demo. We sincerely apologize for that!

However, the new systems are now largely complete. We're polishing and adding more content, and plan to showcase a more complete gameplay experience at the Steam NextFest next year!

In preparation, we're also designing a new demo with richer content for the NextFest. Due to significant system changes, save files may not be compatible either. To avoid potential issues and reduce maintenance costs so we can focus on the new build, we'll be temporarily taking down the current demo in the coming weeks, estimated to be back up in January.

Thank you for your patience and understanding!

FarStar Studio Development Team

◆ Mechanics Update
Chant cards will not disappear when switching characters

notes.title: Emblem of Valor - 2023 Update roadmap
notes.content:
Dear players,

We are thrilled to announce the Emblem of Valor demo version earlier this month, we are also actively working on adding an English version and plan to release it in our next game update. For English players, we apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your patience and understanding.

We would also like to share with you our development plans for the rest of the year.

[h2]Q2-Q3 2023: Improvement of Core Game Features (Simultaneous Update with Demo Version)[/h2]

For the next two quarters, our main focus will be on improving the existing systems and gameplay experience of the game, as well as addressing the feedback and issues from the demo version. The specific items are as follows:

1. Support for multiple languages.
2. Addition of victory screen.
3. Improve the visual display of card effects and descriptions.
4. Improve the process of multi-character battles and target selection of cards.
5. Battle and quest logs.
6. Improve our art and sound effects.
7. Addition of game content, including cards, items, equipment, etc.
8. Balance adjustments.
9. Other minor improvements.

[h2]Q4 2023 - Q1 2024: Early Access Content for Official Release[/h2]

Around the end of this year or early next year, if there are no major obstacles during development, we plan to release the game officially on Steam in early access mode. The official release version will have the following major differences compared to the demo version, and will be our main development focus in the latter half of this year:

1. More classes and characters.
2. More cards, items, and equipment.
3. Main storyline.
4. Randomly generated quests and levels.
5. Difficulty adjustments and advanced challenges.
6. Meta progression elements.

The above is our development plan for the game's future. In addition to the items mentioned above, we have many ideas that we are still considering, but they may not necessarily appear in future versions. Our main goal is to deliver a complete gaming experience to our players! If you have any questions about the above plan, please feel free to let us know.

Finally, if you enjoy our game, please consider adding it to your wishlist and supporting us!

notes.title: Emblem of Valor Demo (English version now available!)
notes.content:
Dear players,

We are thrilled to announce that after over two years of development, Emblem of Valor has finally launched its first public demo version on Steam, and the English version is also supported now! This version includes two different character classes and three levels in the training mode. It also features the core experience of multi-character battles, job switching, and the Mist system. We hope you have a great time playing!

As developers, it is truly heartwarming to see our game on Steam and we are grateful for the players who have tried it out and provided feedback along the way. Being our first game on Steam, Emblem of Valor still has room for improvement in various aspects. With the release of this demo version, we hope to gain a better understanding of players' thoughts and gradually make the game more mature and enjoyable.

Lastly, if you enjoy our game, please consider adding it to your wishlist to show your support! Thanks for all the support and have a great day!
